list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are in our own words; each cites the source it was drawn from.

trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. Everything is single-player and offline, so no online play or DLC is needed for the platinum.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission, so this pops naturally and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops once the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero, is done.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4. A gold, unmissable story trophy: keep a manual save from just before it, since the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) once it unlocks after the story, and work through it. PowerPyx notes the checklist is lenient, close to 60% of true completion rather than everything in the game, and nothing on it is missable, so it can all be finished in free-roam after the credits. It is the longest grind in the game and the hardest trophy by most guides.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; the under-the-bridge runs are the quickest to rack up. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities to see which types you have done. Most come up naturally during the story and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Only gold medals count, so replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it is gold. PowerPyx maps every range and challenge.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, 42 races in total. Each location has its own race, so you need a win at every one of the 14, not just 14 wins anywhere.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so pick the 20 easiest and work through them; car races, race challenges and drone races all feed the activity tracker.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. You must reach the end of all its levels; bonus challenges are not needed. The first three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Finish all 5 of her quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. The quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you and is marked KR in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. He goes quiet during parts of the story but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, as Jason. Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) among them; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. All strands are still there in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list; delivering one in good condition pays more. Doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest; once enough are gone Tyrone offers Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, spread over 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as two toward the total. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia meditates on the balcony of Jason's house in the morning. Talk to her in the kitchen, follow her out and accept. That one disappears after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. Track spots under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 1 only: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, after the mission Down to Earth. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason, Jason only, and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His questline is about hunting the animals he requests and bringing them back; he hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle in the first quest. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work through his hunts and the 15 Target Decks and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets hidden across Leonida; you only need 3 full sets, so pick the sets whose cards you find first and finish those. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: hold Up, then R1 while looking at a scannable object. Any 100 count. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so the landmarks and curiosities alone nearly get you there. Scan as you travel and it finishes on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges, tracked under Progress, then Challenges. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there. Pick the easiest ones first and leave the hardest for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. Partners become available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; call yours with Right plus Triangle. PowerPyx suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as the easiest escape, since cops and the helicopter struggle to follow you on the tracks. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, so you can bring your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while holding your wanted level the whole time. Do not lose the cops between shops. Bring armour, sticky bombs and healing; the pop can lag about 30 seconds after the third shop. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, make a good run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1 while looking at a vehicle. You only need to scan them, not drive them, so a busy road gives you dozens fast. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this pops early.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, L3 plus R3 while aiming. It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, and level it up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. Gang-operation enemies work; PowerPyx reports it does not seem to trigger on soldiers, police or civilians. Use an accurate full-auto rifle.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. The planes sitting on the open airfield do not count. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs you get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun; kicking the door sets the alarm off. Find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe without being detected. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, Wait at the Cafe, which teaches vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 a tip. There are 8 large bank jobs; 5 pop the trophy and all 8 are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The same Chapter 4 mission that teaches bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is, counts as an armored-truck robbery, so it pops there. An earlier method: block a truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door and escape. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every fogged area until none is left. PowerPyx's unfog guide names the best early plane for the job.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and all 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN: at launch no guide has a confirmed method for this trophy. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so treat any method you see online as an unconfirmed lead until a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: PowerPyx — method not yet known at launch

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City, hack it, and drive straight out through the showroom window. Only that blue Banshee counts: a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep driving away from the showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, marked automatically, rob the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which sticky bombs open. The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum strength at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs, found by filtering Map, then Activities, for them, with both characters together: call your partner with Right plus Triangle, and while one trains the other trains too, so progress doubles. You can also work out at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The trophy list itself tracks the count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, to see each one register. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes and fights all count, and most players reach 500 naturally while working on the other trophies. Warning from PowerPyx: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes cops far more aggressive, so avoid piling on excessive violence.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, with a lead, not confirmed, that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Do not chase the lead as fact; wait for a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: PowerPyx — method not yet known at launch (lead: Payday Loans store)

trophies.guide: Reported method, from PowerPyx: at night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it, and help the woman it drops off by going back to her car. The spawn is slightly random: if the car is not there, drive away and return. Treat this as reported, not fully confirmed, while launch-week reports come in.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, with a lead, not confirmed, that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Wait for a confirmed method rather than grinding the lead.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: PowerPyx — method not yet known at launch (lead: motorcycle kick)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, Meet Raul's Crew, you get the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver $250,000 in total in marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays best. It counts across many robberies, not in one trip, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they clear the total fastest. It counts across every shop type: Ammu-Nation, mod shops, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, tattoo studios and electronics.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, Steal the Crawler for Moses. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 are the fastest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, Take A Vehicle to Moses. First buy enough garages, see Little Boxes, for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
